title: INFUSE: A Unified Surface Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.20776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly execute long-horizon, end-to-end workflows involving shell commands, code modification, dependency installation, and interaction with remote services. This growing autonomy expands their exposure to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where adversarial instructions embedded in external content are interpreted as legitimate task directives. Existing evaluations, however, often focus on isolated malicious strings, single-step tool calls, or narrowly scoped agent configurations. We introduce INFUSE, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating IPI throughout the lifecycle of long-horizon agent workflows. INFUSE comprises 40 realistic tasks and a structured taxonomy of 56 attack scenarios spanning five threat categories. Attacks are injected through realistic interaction surfaces encountered during task execution, extending evaluation beyond attacks placed only in initial prompts or isolated tool interactions. translated_title: INFUSE：面向智能体系统中间接提示注入的统一交互面基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地执行涉及shell命令、代码修改、依赖安装以及与远程服务交互的长时间跨度、端到端工作流。这种日益增强的自主性扩大了它们暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）的风险——在间接提示注入中，嵌入在外部内容中的对抗性指令会被解读为合法的任务指令。然而，现有评估往往只关注孤立的恶意字符串、单步工具调用或范围狭窄的智能体配置。我们提出了INFUSE，这是一个端到端的基准测试，用于在长时间跨度智能体工作流的整个生命周期中评估IPI。INFUSE包含40个真实任务以及一个涵盖五大威胁类别、共56个攻击场景的结构化分类体系。攻击通过任务执行过程中遇到的真实交互面进行注入，将评估范围从仅放置在初始提示或孤立工具交互中的攻击扩展开来。我们评估……
tldr: INFUSE是一个端到端基准测试，通过40个真实任务和涵盖五大威胁类别的56个攻击场景，并经由任务执行中的真实交互面注入攻击，首次在长时间跨度智能体工作流的全生命周期内系统评估间接提示注入风险。
en_tdlr: INFUSE is an end-to-end benchmark that systematically evaluates indirect prompt injection across the full lifecycle of long-horizon agent workflows, comprising 40 realistic tasks and 56 attack scenarios across five threat categories, with attacks injected through realistic interaction surfaces encountered during task execution.
